native_mechanisms: A grey wax trough where each mark's impression is pressed atop all prior impressions before any can cool clean (unresolved accumulating superposition of marks).
Seven tuned insect-swarms bite a dipped wire in counts fixed forever by a forward-only spinning slate wheel (seven distinct hungers, irreversible forward-only ratchet).
A brine basin freezes the wire's bite-pattern into a unique frost-flower lattice, sketched to tin as the final token (a slow final crystallisation step producing the output).
core_technique: Multi-lane (7x64-bit) striped multiply-rotate accumulation over 56-byte blocks with an overlapping final block, length folding, and an xxHash/murmur-style xor-shift-multiply finalizer — i.e. the known xxHash design.
